content: तिलकः [तिल्-क्वुन्, तिल इवार्थे स्वल्पे वा कन् वा] .²1 A species of tree with beautiful flowers; <ls>Rām. 2. 94. 9</ls>; आक्रान्ता तिलकक्रियापि तिलकैलींनद्विरेफाञ्जनैः <ls>M. 3</ls>, <ls n="M.">5</ls>; न खलु शोभयति स्म वनस्थलीं न तिलकस्तिलकः प्रमदामिव <ls>R. 9. 41</ls>. Kālidāsa describes the beauty of this tree as being akin to that of the saffron-mark on the forehead of a woman. The name suggests a relation to {%tila%}, the sesame plant, Sesamum indicum Linn. Now this plant has got flowers that have got a very pretty appearance. It is a shrub and not a tree. It grows four to five feet in height. Its flower has five petals. The lower petal is the longest. In wild variety there is a promiment spot on the longest petal which is highly suggestive of the saffron-mark on the forehead of a woman. .²2 A freckle or natural mark under the skin. .²3 The sesamum tree. .{@-कः, -कम्@} .²1 A mark made with sandalwood or unguents <ab>&c.</ab>; मुखे मधुश्रीस्तिलकं प्रकाश्य <ls>Ku. 3. 30</ls>; कस्तूरिकातिलकमालि विधाय सायम् <ls>Bv. 2. 4</ls>, <ls n="Bv.">1. 121</ls>. .²2 The ornament of anything (used at the end of <ab>comp.</ab> in the sense of ‘best’, ‘chief’ or ‘distinguished’); कुल˚; जीवलोक˚ <ls>Māl. 9. 21</ls>; यस्य न विपदि विषादः संपदि हर्षो रणे न भीरुत्वम् . तं भुवनत्रयतिलकं जनयति जननी सुतं विरलम् .. <ls>Pt. 1. 105</ls>. .²3 The burden of a song (ध्रुवक). .{@-का@} A kind of necklace. .{@-कम्@} .²1 The bladder. .²2 The right lung. .²3 A kind of salt. .²4 A kind of disease, the appearance of dark spots on the skin without any inflammation. .²5 Alliteration.
